name: SG-FAILURE-DESK-0
note: Machine-readable form of PRE-REG SG-FAILURE-DESK-0 (zero-main-model-training desk on the retained SYNTHETIC-GRADIENT-WRITER-1 qualification snapshots; the prose governs). No birth authorized.
status: sealed; Artin GO 2026-09-11 for design + prereg + implementation + the desk on a clean auditor

states.step_0: read once (the control's step_00000.pt); init digests asserted equal across the five cells
states.predictors: pred_step_<n>.pt of every SG cell at every desk step, digest asserted against logs/sgwriter1/qual.jsonl pred_snapshots
states.digest_assertion: every model and predictor state digest asserted against logs/sgwriter1/qual.jsonl before it is read

probe_split.split_policy: interleaved by chunk: the probe chunks are curriculum / length ordered (eligible tokens per chunk 856, 1123, 1325, 1520, 1772, 2177, 2787, 4330), so even / odd halves each span the ladder; FIT 6,740 eligible tokens, HELDOUT 9,150; a held-out score is an interleaved-difficulty generalization readout, not iid

oracles.inputs: [h_l, e, 1] = [x_{l+1} (384), dL/dlogits (40), bias]: the registered predictor inputs
oracles.target: Y_l = delta^BP_l / s_l with the sealed arena constants (parameter-detached teacher pass at the snapshot's W)
oracles.linear_ridge: linear ridge with lambda by FIT-only GCV over the relative grid {1e-10 .. 1} x tr(X^T X)/d_in on the non-null eigen-directions of X^T X (below 1e-12 of the largest dropped, pinv-like); conditioning check, reported for the record
oracles.linear_lstsq: least squares by pinv with singular values below 1e-6 of the largest truncated (the same null-direction law as the GCV ridge's 1e-12 on X^T X eigenvalues); PRIMARY. Smoke-driven: the untruncated pinv extrapolated by 100x to 1800x on the interleaved smoke split
oracles.rf_ridge: richer frozen-state oracle: ridge on [X, relu(Z Omega + b)] with Z = FIT-standardized [h, e] clipped to [-3, 3] (smoke-driven: unclipped features extrapolated by 2x to 16000x on heavy-tailed hidden states), 2048 random features, Omega ~ N(0, 1/sqrt(d_in)), b ~ N(0, 1), torch.Generator seed 777 (the family contains the linear one as a function class; one shared lambda may under-use it); lambda by the same FIT-only GCV law
readouts: held_ratio = sum ||Y - Yhat||^2 / sum ||Y||^2 on HELDOUT (zero-baseline ratio)
oracles.richer_readout: for the branch B / C labels the richer oracle's ratio is min(linear_lstsq, rf_ridge_gcv) per block

online_tracking.match: phi_t on HELDOUT inputs / targets of W_t: ratio, cos
online_tracking.prev_next: phi_t on HELDOUT inputs / targets of the previous and next desk snapshot; the lag varies with the desk step spacing (565 to 3,084 steps) and is read per lag, never pooled into one median
online_tracking.nonstationarity: cos(Y_t, Y_next) and RMS(Y_next) / RMS(Y_t) per block on HELDOUT

dynamics: hat_delta RMS (SG cells) and hat / delta RMS ratio
block-parameter-gradient cosine cos(J^T hat_delta, frozen-top BP gradient) per SG block, accumulated over HELDOUT chunks
residual effective rank of x_{l+1}, all eight blocks (dfa_act.effective_rank law, HELDOUT eligible tokens)
output-gradient RMS (RMS of dL/dlogits over eligible positions)

thresholds_descriptive.GOOD: median over desk steps >= 463 and blocks 4..7 of linear_lstsq held_ratio <= 0.5
thresholds_descriptive.online_bad: median held ratio of phi_t at its matching W_t >= 0.9
thresholds_descriptive.richer_good: median over steps >= 463 and blocks of min(linear_lstsq, rf_ridge_gcv) held_ratio <= 0.5 while the linear_lstsq median > 0.5
thresholds_descriptive.collapse_target: baseline_mse_held < 1e-4 on some block at some desk step >= 463
thresholds_descriptive.collapse_rank: effective rank of x_{l+1} < 3 for some l in 4..7 (receipt keys 4..7, i.e. the outputs of blocks 4..7) at some desk step >= 463
thresholds_descriptive.collapse_readout: head.weight Frobenius norm or norm.g L2 norm outside [0.5x, 2x] of the control's at the same desk step
thresholds_descriptive.sg_only: a collapse readout that fires on an SG cell and not on the control at the same step

interpretation_tree: A: linear oracle GOOD and online predictor BAD  => tracking / optimizer / timescale failure; SG remains live
B: linear oracle POOR (or not GOOD) and rf_ridge GOOD => capacity / context failure of the (h, e) -> delta linear family
C: linear and rf_ridge oracles POOR => the current (h, e) -> delta^BP SG formulation closes

D: SG-only target / rank / readout collapse => self-induced bad-basin hypothesis supported descriptively (coincidence readout: at the first desk step where an MLP cell's baseline_mse_held < 1e-4, its rank at blocks 5..8 and its head / norm norms v the control's at the same step)
branches are descriptive labels; several may hold at once (per cell); none is a bar; nothing here tunes an SG birth

registered_prior.rf_ridge_median_held_ratio_linear_cells: within 0.1 of the linear_lstsq median (the random features do not add representable structure), p 0.6
registered_prior.online_bad: true on all four SG cells (p 0.9)
registered_prior.mlp_target_collapse_coincides_with_rank_: at the outputs of blocks 4..7 (receipt keys 4..7); p 0.6
registered_prior.linear_lstsq_median_held_ratio_linear_ce: 0.3 to 0.9 (a partial fit: the teacher target is not a linear function of (x_{l+1}, e) alone)

cost_min: about 60 to 90 (46 states, fp64 CPU; HELDOUT 9,150 tokens)
does_not_authorize: any writer birth (delayed-target, bootstrapped-target, new family, seed-2, MeZO, target-prop, equilibrium-prop, mechanism)
checkpoint_policy: checkpoints/sgwriter1/ intact through the desk booking; then a compact keep set is proposed (not executed)
receipt_binding: desk.json carries source_sha256 of scratch/sg_failure_desk.py and scratch/sg_credit.py
